planned: Owned persistent player reference dialogs follow/hide/restore by Qt ownership rather than a fixed per-dialog list. Preserve reading and manual close; transient game hover and map overlay retain freshness rules; defer following during supported modal tasks.
acceptance: Actual source event/stage/statistics windows and nested readers; accepted/ignored close while suspended, deleted views, parent source loss during restore, hotkey round-trip, modal preservation, pin/unpin behavior and no current-run mutation. No game capture or input/chat.
external_first: Inspected PyWinCtl official README/docs/source applicability; OS window objects cannot replace Qt object/source lifecycle. Use existing Qt6.11.2 ownership/close dispatch APIs for this small bridge; not a newly adopted external package. Existing external theme/collapsible/Flow stay.
